pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal brown patches with irregular, slightly serrated edges exhibiting moderate pixel-level gradients at the margins. Spatial area of individual patches is greatest on the mid-flank, decreasing in size and becoming more elongated towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored network with high-contrast interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively uniform across the lateral surface, with slight narrowing at the transition to the lower appendages.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The frequency of the jagged hair tips is high and uniform against the blurred background.
